Retained (c) —-1,800 = + -1,800 - +1,800 = -1,800 Prepaid Rent rent expense After this adjustment, the income statement properly reflects the $1,800 rent expense for the month of December, and the balance sheet properly reflects the remaining balance of $9,000 (the $10,800 payment minus the amount expired of $1,800) in the Prepaid Rent account as of December 31. Examples of other prepaid expenses for which similar adjustments are made include prepaid insur- ance and prepaid advertising.
